emotional_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Precision, High-Density Data, Tactical Clarity)

brand_identity.logo_spec: Top-left corner of header. Icon + wordmark with crisp cyan-blue accent indicator dot/accent mark. Typographic placeholder with logo icon container.
brand_identity.tagline: AI-Powered PDF Table Extraction & Validation Pipeline

theme_system.fouc_prevention: Inline script in index.html to read localStorage before React renders and apply 'dark' class to html root element

toggle_control.type: Single circular button on far right of header
toggle_control.behavior: Click opens a compact dropdown menu with 3 options: Sun (Claro), Moon (Oscuro), Monitor (Sistema). Active mode icon displayed on trigger button.
toggle_control.style: Perfect circle pill, bg #0E1525 (dark) or #1E293B, border 1.5px luminous cyan #38BDF8 with 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35) glow, crisp off-white icon #F5F7FA, smooth 180ms hover and focus transitions

toggle_control.position: Immediately to the left of the theme toggle button in the header
toggle_control.style: Pill-shaped toggle button, bg #0E1525, border 1.5px luminous cyan #38BDF8 with glowing box-shadow 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35), globe icon + uppercase language code ('ES' / 'EN') in 12px semibold/bold sans-serif font, white text #F5F7FA, gap 8px-12px between buttons in header group

header.type: Sticky top bar across all pages
structure: Left: Logo 'Anclora TableExtract' with glowing cyan accent dot
Center: Navigation links (Cargar PDFs, Revisor Spreadsheet, Historial, Métricas)
Right: Language toggle ('ES'/'EN') + Theme circular menu toggle, spaced 10px apart

layout_and_navigation.main_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6

drag_drop_zone.description: Multi-PDF upload with drag-and-drop zone, page selector & preview thumbnails
features: Interactive PDF page preview thumbnails with toggleable selection checkboxes
OCR fallback auto-detection indicator (Camelot/pdfplumber native vs Tesseract OCR)
Extraction parameters panel (date format, decimal separator, header detection sensitivity)

spreadsheet_grid.description: ag-grid style high-density data review grid with cell-level confidence scores
features: Cell color highlights: Green (>=90%), Amber (60-89%), Red (<60%)
Toggle 'Solo celdas dudosas' (Filter to view only amber and red cells)
Inline cell editor with keyboard navigation (Enter/Tab/Esc) and real-time validation
Batch normalizers for dates (YYYY-MM-DD), numbers (1.234,56 -> 1234.56), and currency units
Confidence breakdown drawer/popover showing page number, bounding box coordinates & OCR score

export_panel.description: Download modal/drawer with configurable export options
options: Export corrected version vs original extraction

history_view.description: Document history table with status badges and re-download links

auth.description: Google Auth modal or header profile menu with avatar, email, and mock auth states

image_urls.description: Financial document review and table extraction workflow background
Data processing and quality score monitoring screen
Document auditing and financial table validation action

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='theme-toggle-button', data-testid='language-toggle-button', data-testid='filter-doubtful-cells-button', data-testid='export-xlsx-button')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA compliant contrast ratios for both dark and light modes across all green/amber/red cell states

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the theme and language preferences stored in localStorage to ensure seamless refresh without FOUC.
Implement the exact header group with 'ES/EN' pill toggle on the left and circular theme toggle on the right with glowing cyan borders (#38BDF8).
Build the spreadsheet data grid with high performance, inline editing capabilities, keyboard navigation, and doubt filter toggle.
Provide rich mock PDF processing simulation for Camelot/pdfplumber native extraction and fallback Tesseract OCR with realistic tabular data.
Support full bilingual translations (Spanish default / English) across all labels, tooltips, toasts, modals, and exported headers.
Always include data-testid on buttons, inputs, tables, toggles, and modals for automated validation.
